message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您想知道「今天美國的黃金價格」，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供實時黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格，並附有歷史走勢圖。 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞平台，提供即時黃金價格及相關分析。 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 亦提供即時黃金價格與市場動態。 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 以圖表方式呈現黃金價格走勢，並可設定提醒。 |

如果您需要更精確的數字（例如「今日黃金價格為每盎司 1,950.30 美元」），請直接前往上述網站或使用金融資訊 API（如 Bloomberg API、Alpha Vantage 等）來取得最新數據。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price per ounce. But we should clarify that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a recent approximate value. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Kitco, Bloomberg, etc. Provide typical range.
